# Day Schedule

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The time-blocked calendar of appointments and commitments for a day.

## Scope note

Time-specific commitments; distinct from DayPlan's priority list.

- [Day Cluster Support](../DayClusterSupport/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
